description: JavaScript code for Accounts module in vtiger CRM, including functions for setting return values, address handling, map search, and UI interactions.

methods.name: set_return
methods.description: Sets parent name and ID in the opener window based on product selection.

methods.name: set_return_specific
methods.description: Sets account name and ID in the opener window for DetailView.

methods.name: add_data_to_relatedlist
methods.description: Updates related emails with entity and record IDs.

methods.name: set_return_formname_specific
methods.description: Sets account name and ID in a specific form in the opener window.

methods.name: set_return_address
methods.description: Populates address fields in the opener window and prompts for overwrite confirmation.

methods.name: set_return_contact_address
methods.description: Populates contact address fields in the opener window.

methods.name: submitform
methods.description: Submits a form for mass deletion with specified entity ID.

methods.name: searchMapLocation
methods.description: Opens Google Maps with address details for location search.

methods.name: getRelatedLink
methods.description: Opens Alexa traffic details for a website.

methods.name: populateData
methods.description: Populates account edit view fields with data from the page.

methods.name: showhide
methods.description: Shows or hides specified div elements.

methods.name: findPosX
methods.description: Calculates X position of an element.

methods.name: findPosY
methods.description: Calculates Y position of an element.

methods.name: just
methods.description: Animates the display of a UI component.

methods.name: closet
methods.description: Animates hiding of a UI component.

methods.name: fnDown
methods.description: Toggles display of a description section.

methods.name: set_return_todo
methods.description: Sets parent task info in the createTodo form.

methods.name: checkAddress
methods.description: Updates address info via AJAX and prompts for contact address change.
